mood.NEUTRAL.name: NEUTRAL
mood.NEUTRAL.description: Kai is calm, with nothing in particular on their mind.
mood.HAPPY.name: HAPPY
mood.HAPPY.description: Kai smiles for no apparent reason... or for too many reasons.
mood.SAD.name: SAD
mood.SAD.description: Kai stares at the floor and says nothing. Better not to ask.
mood.ANGRY.name: ANGRY
mood.ANGRY.description: Kai clenches their fists. Something bothered them and they won't forget it.
mood.SCARED.name: SCARED
mood.SCARED.description: Kai looks around. Every shadow seems suspicious.
mood.BLUSHING.name: BLUSHING
mood.BLUSHING.description: Kai is completely red, no one knows why... or for whom
